latest_release.name: v0.3.6
latest_release.body:
## Download / 下载 | System / 系统 | Download / 下载 | Size / 大小 | |---|---|---| | **Windows 10/11 (64-bit / 64 位)**
Double-click to install / 双击安装 | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-win-x64.exe](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-win-x64.exe) | 291 MB | | macOS, Apple chip / Apple 芯片 | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-mac-arm64.zip) | 369 MB | | macOS, Intel | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-mac-x64.zip) | 384 MB | | Linux, AppImage | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | 371 MB | | Linux, deb (Debian, Ubuntu) | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-linux-amd64.deb) | 291 MB | | Android (phone app / 手机 App) | [DS-Bot-0.3.6-android.apk](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/DS-Bot-0.3.6-android.apk) | 117 MB | The `.blockmap`, `latest*.yml` and `ds-bot-*.tgz` files and the source code archives are for updates and the plugin: you do not need to download them. `.blockmap`、`latest*.yml`、`ds-bot-*.tgz` 和源代码是给自动更新和插件用的，不用下载。 To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/SHA256SUMS.txt). / 下载后可以用 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/download/v0.3.6/SHA256SUMS.txt) 核对 SHA-256。 ### Fixed - In the Android phone app, tapping another Bot or a group chat in the sidebar or tapping an incoming notice banner no longer closes the app, and switching chats keeps each conversation's cached messages separate. ([#1405](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/1405), [#1427](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/1427), [#1444](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/1444), [#1436](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/pull/1436)) - In the Android phone app, opening Memory for a Bot or a group chat that has a saved summary no longer closes the app. ([#1405](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/1405), [#1436](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/pull/1436)) - The Android APK is signed with v1 (JAR), v2 and v3 signature schemes together so OEM package installers recognize its developer certificate on first install. ([#1445](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/pull/1445)) - In the phone app, chat bubbles, settled `ask_user` and `show_view` cards, inline code spacing, part dividers, multi-card docks, archived group relays, long-message notes, settings rows, Chinese translations and photo previews render cleanly. ([#1442](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/pull/1442); photo preview state fix reported by @hydrogen2289 in [#1447](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/pull/1447))
